subject: Next steps: security onboarding for Ignite — SOC2, IR timelines, BCP evidence
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ignite.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-28T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: security onboarding for Ignite — SOC2, IR timelines, BCP evidence

Hi Sarah —

Great speaking with you and Rajiv this morning. Thanks for the time and for walking through the integration surface area. As promised, here is a concise recap and the immediate security artifacts your team requested so Procurement and SecurityOps can move forward.

Key items we covered (brief):
- Scope: hosted API for inference, Dedicated reserved capacity pilot for PII workloads, optional VPC for production.
- Compliance priorities: SOC 2 (type II), GDPR data residency controls, incident response (HIPAA considerations were flagged for a specific workload).
- Timeline ask: Ignite needs confirmation of breach notification timelines and examples of BCP/DR evidence for legal/procurement.

Next steps (action owners):
1) Vivek (me) — attach the SOC 2 summary, redacted IR playbook excerpt, and a security questionnaire template for your team to fill. Expected: today.
2) Ignite — return the completed vendor questionnaire and any procurement contract comments. Expected: within 5 business days.
3) Monica — lead availability for a short technical deep-dive on encryption and key management (KM integrations).
4) Logan — pricing and pilot SOW follow-up.

Attached: Ignite_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (initial questionnaire you can forward to SecurityOps), SOC2-Report-Redwood-2024.pdf (redacted), IR_Playbook_Summary.docx (excerpt showing notification timelines and post-incident steps).

A couple of clarifications we verbally covered on IR/BCP that you'll want in writing:
- Breach notification: Redwood commits to initial notification within 72 hours of confirming a security incident that affects customer data; we provide a suspected-impact summary at discovery and a follow-up detailed report as investigations conclude.
- BCP/DR: our dedicated capacity regions have cross-zone failover and documented RTO targets — we can share evidence artifacts (DR test reports) under an NDA or as redacted evidence as part of the procurement review.

If Procurement wants specific artifacts (runbooks, DR test reports, or SOC 2 Type II full report under NDA) let me know which ones and I'll route through Legal.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

--

Attachment: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2024.pdf (application/pdf, redacted)

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ignite.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@ignite.ai>, procurement@ignite.ai, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: security onboarding for Ignite — SOC2, IR timelines, BCP evidence

Hi Vivek —

Thanks — that captures the call well. We have a couple of immediate asks from our SecurityOps and Procurement teams:

1) Can you confirm whether the 72-hour notification window is measured from discovery or confirmation? Our policy requires notification from confirmation, and we need the text reflected in an addendum.
2) Procurement wants a sample redacted DR test report (we don't need full logs, just the executive summary of the last two tests). Can that be provided as a PDF?
3) Our SecurityOps will start the vendor questionnaire — please confirm the preferred contact to route any follow-ups (technical vs. legal).

Attached is our initial Vendor Security Questionnaire (filled blank) — we've inserted a few notes where we need detail: question sections 3, 7, and 12.

Sarah
Sarah Lim
Head of Security Operations | Ignite Analytics
sarah.lim@ignite.ai
+1 (650) 555-2199

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ignite.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-28T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps: security onboarding for Ignite — SOC2, IR timelines, BCP evidence

Hi Sarah —

Quick answers and the artifacts we can share without NDA:
- "72 hours" wording: our standard is 72 hours from confirmation. We'll provide a short addendum template line that Procurement can include in the SOW: "Redwood will provide initial customer notification within 72 hours of confirming a security incident that materially affects customer data."
- DR test report: I've uploaded a redacted executive summary from our Q1 and Q4 2024 DR exercises to a secure drive link (see Related Links). We can produce a PDF extract for you to attach to procurement materials.
- Preferred contact: For technical follow-ups, route to me (monica.patel@redwoodinference.com). For legal/NDA/contract redlines, please copy legal@redwoodinference.com and Vivek.

Action items on our side:
- I will prepare the addendum wording and a redacted DR executive summary PDF and deliver by end of day.
- Legal will be looped if Ignite requests the full SOC 2 Type II report.

Logistics: can we schedule a 30-minute follow-up tomorrow for the questionnaire clarifications (sections 3/7/12)? I'm available 9:00–11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0163

Date: 2025-07-28T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: security onboarding for Ignite — SOC2, IR timelines, BCP evidence

Thanks everyone —

I'll get a draft SOW addendum (pricing and pilot terms) ready once we confirm the artifacts Ignite needs attached to the PO. If Procurement confirms they only need the SOC2 summary and a redacted DR exec summary, we can keep the SOW light and avoid an NDA. If they want the full SOC2 report, we'll need an NDA first and that will add ~2 business days.

I'll also propose two cadence options for the pilot (2-week proof-of-concept vs. 8-week production pilot) and share estimated committed throughput for Dedicated capacity. Vivek — I'll loop Legal if Ignite returns any contract redlines.

Best,
Logan Wright
